Q8245.reason: The absolute threshold is the level detected 50% of the time, which is 15 of 30 mice at 70% power (80% gave 67% and 60% gave 33%), though the power levels are never mapped to decibels.

Q8128.reason: Exertional cough with resolution at rest, an asthmatic sibling, and normal baseline spirometry fit exercise-induced asthma, since normal findings between episodes do not exclude it.
